archive.normalization: GitHub API log text has line endings normalized to LF and one final newline; this is retained text, not an original server ZIP byte claim. Local logs are retained as produced. All archive members were byte-checked against retained originals.

limitations: macOS ARM intentionally skips six core and nine VST3 x86 FTZ/DAZ modes; exact skipped test names are retained.
Linux-only module coexistence checks are not represented as macOS/Windows runs.
Hosted sanitizer success is an observed instrumented run, not a universal race/allocation proof.
No real DAW/audio-device validation, measured specimen fidelity, signing/notarization or release is claimed.
Python diagnostic sources may be developed after this checkpoint; their later tests/evidence are separate.
